cohort: Premature infants with a gestational age of 32 to 36 weeks, discharged from Neonatal Intensive Care Units, and followed up at a high-risk outpatient clinic.
finding: A high incidence of BPD (21.5%) was observed among premature infants, with birth weight, gestational age, and late sepsis identified as statistically associated factors.
followup_time: 36 weeks of corrected gestational age (for BPD diagnosis)
